description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notification on Rates of Exchange effective from 18.12.2017 to 24.12.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, and involves compliance requirements for import/export transactions. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
